title: Be StepWise - Videos
description:
Support for step-parents. We help a step-parent make their families the best blended family they can be. Many difficulties can exist in step-families. Step-parents often feel second best, an outsider, not allowed to share in the co-parenting of their step-child, even in their own home. Their partner may  privilege or indulge their child. The step-parent's partner's ex, might negatively impact the families life. Navigating these problems can seem impossible.
Be StepWise have a wealth of experience gained from working more than ten years in the field. We are qualified step-parenting practitioners. Our mantra is, "get it right so it doesn't go wrong." Getting the right guidance and support saves effort and distress and helps you build a family with all the good things that can be. We are here to help you know what you have to do to make the difference, and to get this important part of your life right. 

See www.bestepwise.co.uk
